figurative_meaning_bn: অসুবিধায় ফেলা, ক্ষতি করা, বাগড়া দেওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: To put someone in trouble, to cause harm, to obstruct or hinder
similar_in_english: throw a wrench in the works
pull the rug out from under someone
example_sentences_in_english: He threw a wrench in my plans.
The friends ganged up to sabotage him.
note: This idiom likely originates from the use of bamboo in rural traps or structures that can cause hindrance, reflecting everyday Bengali rural life.
